organization.name: igebra.ai / AI Ready School
organization.description: AI-focused education ecosystem for students, teachers and schools, with an emphasis on understanding AI, computational thinking, creativity and personalized learning.
organization.knowledge_note: The four program records below are assignment-oriented demo records. They are designed to demonstrate deterministic RAG retrieval and tool calling; current commercial availability, pricing and schedules should be verified with the organization before publication.

programs.name: AI Edge for Kids
programs.short_description: A practical introduction to artificial intelligence for school-age learners, combining AI concepts, safe AI use, creativity and small projects.
programs.audience: Students building their first mental model of AI
outcomes: Explain what AI models do at a high level
programs.demo_pitch: A friendly first step into AI that prioritizes understanding and responsible experimentation rather than simply using AI tools.

programs.name: Coding4AI
programs.short_description: A coding pathway for students who want to build computational thinking skills and connect programming with practical AI projects.
programs.audience: Students ready to move from using technology to building with it
programs.demo_pitch: Best suited to learners who want hands-on building experience and a bridge from coding fundamentals to AI projects.

programs.name: Math++ for AI
programs.short_description: A mathematics and computational-thinking pathway that uses problem solving, patterns and modeling as foundations for AI learning.
programs.audience: Students strengthening mathematical reasoning for AI and computational work
outcomes: Connect mathematical models to real-world systems
Build stronger foundations for AI and data science
prerequisites: School-level mathematics appropriate to the student's grade
programs.demo_pitch: Useful for learners who want stronger mathematical thinking alongside their AI journey.

programs.name: Free Trial Demo
programs.short_description: A no-cost 1-on-1 introductory session used to understand a learner's interests, level and suitable learning pathway.
programs.audience: Parents and students evaluating an AI, coding or math learning pathway
prerequisites: A parent or guardian should participate for younger students
programs.demo_pitch: A low-commitment way to explore fit before selecting a longer learning pathway.

principles: Use AI to develop student thinking rather than simply provide answers.
Keep teachers and educators in the learning loop.
Treat AI literacy as understanding how AI works, its capabilities and its limitations.
Prefer hands-on projects and computational thinking over passive tool usage.
Protect student privacy and avoid requesting unnecessary personal information.
